page.layout: One page of text, with a list in its lower part. A small reference mark stands at the right margin beside one list line. Top right is a faint number that appears to be handwritten, not printed.

main_text.p: veré est Agnus Dei, tribuitur: qua de re exstant vulgati ver-sus, plenissimi impietatis: Lib.1. Ceremoniarum Curia Roma-næ tit 7. in fine.

Balsamus, & munda cera, cum chrismatis unda, Conficiunt agnum, quod manus do tibi magnum Fonte velut natum, per mystica sanctificatum. Fulgura desursum depellit, & omne malignum Peccatum frangit, ut Christi sanguis, & angit, Prægnans servatur, simul & partus liberatur, Munera fert dignis, virtutem destruit ignis, Portatus mundé, de fluctibus eripit undæ.

p.i: Scribitur autē, Urbanum v. Pontificem misisse cum his versibus tres Agnos Dei ad Imperatorem Græcorum.

l.i: Altaria, in quibus celebrentur Missæ & sacrificia fiant.
Ablutio pedum in die cœnæ Domini, pridie Parasceves.
Ablutio altarium. Abstinentia a carnibus diebus vetitis.
Balneæ animarum, quæ animarum in purgatorio recreandarum causa pauperibus calefiunt. Benedictiones placentarum.
Campanarum baptisationes adhibitis patrimis seu suscepto-Ciborum discrimina & delectus.
Chrisma seu unctio infantium in Baptismo & adultorum in confirmatione.
Ciborium seu repositorium, vel theca, in qua asservatur deus Maozim seu deus panaceus, qui circugestatur in pōpa Persica.
Confessio auricularis quæ Sacerdoti fit in aurem.

page.notes: The faint "337" at the top right appears handwritten, so it is left out. "Fonte" in the verse is partly obscured and read as uncertain; it is not marked in the text, but the reading "Fo nte" is doubtful. The "(rib." beside the list line is unclear and is marked [?]. The symbol "⌣" before some list entries is an unclear mark and is copied as a sign. The verse line "Prægnans" shows a gap in the scan. Long s has been normalised to s. No printed error is corrected.
